title: Continuous Monitoring Dashboard
summary: A real-time 'Security Watchtower' dashboard that aggregates the status of all Automated Evidence Agents, providing a live view of compliance health.
goals: Shift from 'point-in-time' audits to continuous compliance.
Alert stakeholders immediately when a control fails.

user_stories.outcome: see a traffic light system (Green/Red) for all connected technical controls.
drill down to see the specific error (e.g., 'S3 Bucket X is invalid').

acceptance_criteria: Status updates via WebSocket (Turbo Stream) when a check completes.
